# HDNRA

The R package **HDNRA** provides inverse-free high-dimensional location
tests for two-sample and general linear hypothesis testing (GLHT)
problems under equal or unequal covariance structures. It implements
classical normal-approximation-based procedures, normal-reference tests
based on covariance-matched Gaussian companions, and F-type
normal-reference calibrations for heteroscedastic Behrens–Fisher and
GLHT settings. Computationally intensive components are implemented in
C++ through [Rcpp](https://github.com/RcppCore/Rcpp) and
[RcppArmadillo](https://github.com/RcppCore/RcppArmadillo).

Version 2.1.0 contains **24 public testing routines** and two real data
sets.

## Implemented data sets and testing routines

Two real data sets in `HDNRA`:

- [COVID19](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/COVID19.html)
- [corneal](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/corneal.html)

Seven normal-reference tests for the two-sample problem:

- [ZGZC2020.TS.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZGZC2020.TS.2cNRT.html)
- [ZZ2022.TS.3cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZ2022.TS.3cNRT.html)
- [ZZZ2020.TS.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZZ2020.TS.2cNRT.html)
- [ZWZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZWZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT.html)
- [ZZ2022.TSBF.3cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZ2022.TSBF.3cNRT.html)
- [ZZGZ2021.TSBF.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZGZ2021.TSBF.2cNRT.html)
- [ZZZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT.html)

Seven normal-reference tests for the GLHT/GLHTBF problem:

- [ZGZ2017.GLHT.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZGZ2017.GLHT.2cNRT.html)
- [ZZ2022.GLHT.3cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZ2022.GLHT.3cNRT.html)
- [ZZZ2022.GLHT.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZZ2022.GLHT.2cNRT.html)
- [ZZ2022.GLHTBF.3cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZ2022.GLHTBF.3cNRT.html)
- [ZZG2022.GLHTBF.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZZG2022.GLHTBF.2cNRT.html)
- [WZ2026.GLHTBF.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/WZ2026.GLHTBF.2cNRT.html)
- [CCXH2024.GLHTBF.2cNRT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/CCXH2024.GLHTBF.2cNRT.html)

Four normal-approximation-based tests for the two-sample problem:

- [BS1996.TS.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/BS1996.TS.NABT.html)
- [SD2008.TS.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/SD2008.TS.NABT.html)
- [CQ2010.TSBF.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/CQ2010.TSBF.NABT.html)
- [SKK2013.TSBF.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/SKK2013.TSBF.NABT.html)

Six normal-approximation-based and benchmark tests for the GLHT/GLHTBF
problem:

- [FHW2004.GLHT.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/FHW2004.GLHT.NABT.html)
- [SF2006.GLHT.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/SF2006.GLHT.NABT.html)
- [YS2012.GLHT.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/YS2012.GLHT.NABT.html)
- [ZGZ2017.GLHTBF.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/ZGZ2017.GLHTBF.NABT.html)
- [S2007.ks.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/S2007.ks.NABT.html)
- [LHNB2025.GLHTBF.NABT](https://nie23wp8738.github.io/HDNRA/reference/LHNB2025.GLHTBF.NABT.html)

## Installation

Install the CRAN release with:

``` r
install.packages("HDNRA")
```

You can also install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/):

``` r
# Installing from GitHub requires devtools or remotes.
install.packages("devtools")
# Or:
install.packages("remotes")

# Install the development version from GitHub.
devtools::install_github("nie23wp8738/HDNRA")
# Or:
remotes::install_github("nie23wp8738/HDNRA")
```

## Usage

### Load the package

``` r
library(HDNRA)
```

### Example data

Package `HDNRA` comes with two real data sets:

``` r
# A COVID-19 transcriptomic data set for the two-sample problem.
?COVID19
data(COVID19)
dim(COVID19)

group1 <- as.matrix(COVID19[c(2:19, 82:87), ])      # healthy controls
group2 <- as.matrix(COVID19[-c(1:19, 82:87), ])     # COVID-19 patients

dim(group1)
dim(group2)

# A corneal topography data set for the GLHT problem.
?corneal
data(corneal)
dim(corneal)

group1 <- as.matrix(corneal[1:43, ])      # normal group
group2 <- as.matrix(corneal[44:57, ])     # unilateral suspect group
group3 <- as.matrix(corneal[58:78, ])     # suspect map group
group4 <- as.matrix(corneal[79:150, ])    # clinical keratoconus group

dim(group1)
dim(group2)
dim(group3)
dim(group4)
```

### Example for the two-sample problem

A simple example using the F-type normal-reference Behrens–Fisher test
[`ZWZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT()`](reference/ZWZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT.md) with the
`COVID19` data set:

``` r
data("COVID19")

group1 <- as.matrix(COVID19[c(2:19, 82:87), ])
group2 <- as.matrix(COVID19[-c(1:19, 82:87), ])

ZWZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT(group1, group2)
```

### Example for the GLHT problem

A simple example using the F-type normal-reference GLHTBF test
[`WZ2026.GLHTBF.2cNRT()`](reference/WZ2026.GLHTBF.2cNRT.md) with the
`corneal` data set:

``` r
data("corneal")

group1 <- as.matrix(corneal[1:43, ])
group2 <- as.matrix(corneal[44:57, ])
group3 <- as.matrix(corneal[58:78, ])
group4 <- as.matrix(corneal[79:150, ])

Y <- list(group1, group2, group3, group4)
k <- length(Y)
n <- vapply(Y, nrow, integer(1))
p <- ncol(Y[[1]])

# Omnibus one-way contrast against the last group.
G <- cbind(diag(k - 1), rep(-1, k - 1))

WZ2026.GLHTBF.2cNRT(Y, G, n, p)
```

A rank-one heteroscedastic GLHTBF example can be run with
[`CCXH2024.GLHTBF.2cNRT()`](reference/CCXH2024.GLHTBF.2cNRT.md):

``` r
B <- c(-2, 1, 2, -1)
CCXH2024.GLHTBF.2cNRT(Y, B, n, p, alpha = 0.05)
```

The random-integration normal-approximation GLHTBF routine
[`LHNB2025.GLHTBF.NABT()`](reference/LHNB2025.GLHTBF.NABT.md) uses a
rank-one coefficient vector and tuning vectors `O` and `A`:

``` r
B <- c(-2, 1, 2, -1)
A <- rep(sqrt(5) * p^(-3 / 8), p)
eps <- 2
O <- sqrt(eps * (1 + 2 * (1:p) / (3 * p)))

LHNB2025.GLHTBF.NABT(Y, B, O, A, n, p)
```

Please note that the HDNRA project is released with a [Contributor Code
of
Conduct](https://contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html).
By contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## Data Sets

- [`COVID19`](COVID19.md) : HDNRA_data COVID19
- [`corneal`](corneal.md) : HDNRA_data corneal

## S3 class ‘NRtest’

- [`NRtest.object()`](NRtest.object.md) : S3 Class "NRtest"
- [`print(`*`<NRtest>`*`)`](print.NRtest.md) : Print Method for S3 Class
  "NRtest"

## Normal-refernece Tests for Two-sample Problem

- [`ZGZC2020.TS.2cNRT()`](ZGZC2020.TS.2cNRT.md) : Normal-reference-test
  with two-cumulant (2-c) matched \$\chi^2\$-approximation for
  two-sample problem proposed by Zhang et al. (2020)
- [`ZWZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT()`](ZWZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT.md) :
  Normal-reference-test with two-cumulant (2-c) matched
  \$\chi^2\$-approximation for two-sample BF problem proposed by Zhu et
  al. (2023)
- [`ZZ2022.TS.3cNRT()`](ZZ2022.TS.3cNRT.md) : Normal-reference-test with
  three-cumulant (3-c) matched \$\chi^2\$-approximation for two-sample
  problem proposed by Zhang and Zhu (2022)
- [`ZZ2022.TSBF.3cNRT()`](ZZ2022.TSBF.3cNRT.md) : Normal-reference-test
  with three-cumulant (3-c) matched \$\chi^2\$-approximation for
  two-sample BF problem proposed by Zhang and Zhu (2022)
- [`ZZGZ2021.TSBF.2cNRT()`](ZZGZ2021.TSBF.2cNRT.md) :
  Normal-reference-test with two-cumulant (2-c) matched
  \$\chi^2\$-approximation for two-sample BF problem proposed by Zhang
  et al. (2021)
- [`ZZZ2020.TS.2cNRT()`](ZZZ2020.TS.2cNRT.md) : Normal-reference-test
  with two-cumulant (2-c) matched \$\chi^2\$-approximation for
  two-sample problem proposed by Zhang et al. (2020)
- [`ZZZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT()`](ZZZ2023.TSBF.2cNRT.md) :
  Normal-reference-test with two-cumulant (2-c) matched
  \$\chi^2\$-approximation for two-sample BF problem proposed by Zhang
  et al. (2023)

## Normal-refernece Tests for GLHT Problem

- [`CCXH2024.GLHTBF.2cNRT()`](CCXH2024.GLHTBF.2cNRT.md) :
  Normal-reference-test with two-cumulant (2-c) matched
  \$\chi^2\$-approximation for GLHT problem proposed by Cao et al.
  (2024)
- [`ZGZ2017.GLHT.2cNRT()`](ZGZ2017.GLHT.2cNRT.md) :
  Normal-reference-test with two-cumulant (2-c) matched
  \$\chi^2\$-approximation for GLHT problem proposed Zhang et al. (2017)
- [`ZZ2022.GLHT.3cNRT()`](ZZ2022.GLHT.3cNRT.md) : Normal-reference-test
  with three-cumulant (3-c) matched \$\chi^2\$-approximation for GLHT
  problem proposed by Zhu and Zhang (2022)
- [`ZZ2022.GLHTBF.3cNRT()`](ZZ2022.GLHTBF.3cNRT.md) :
  Normal-reference-test with three-cumulant (3-c) matched
  \$\chi^2\$-approximation for GLHT problem under heteroscedasticity
  proposed by Zhang and Zhu (2022)
- [`ZZG2022.GLHTBF.2cNRT()`](ZZG2022.GLHTBF.2cNRT.md) :
  Normal-reference-test with two-cumulant (2-c) matched
  \$\chi^2\$-approximation for GLHT problem under heteroscedasticity
  proposed by Zhang et al. (2022)
- [`ZZZ2022.GLHT.2cNRT()`](ZZZ2022.GLHT.2cNRT.md) :
  Normal-reference-test with two-cumulant (2-c) matched
  \$\chi^2\$-approximation for GLHT problem proposed by Zhu et al.
  (2022)

## Some Existing Tests for Two-sample Problem

- [`BS1996.TS.NABT()`](BS1996.TS.NABT.md) : Normal-approximation-based
  test for two-sample problem proposed by Bai and Saranadasa (1996)
- [`CQ2010.TSBF.NABT()`](CQ2010.TSBF.NABT.md) :
  Normal-approximation-based test for two-sample BF problem proposed by
  Chen and Qin (2010)
- [`SD2008.TS.NABT()`](SD2008.TS.NABT.md) : Normal-approximation-based
  test for two-sample problem proposed by Srivastava and Du (2008)
- [`SKK2013.TSBF.NABT()`](SKK2013.TSBF.NABT.md) :
  Normal-approximation-based test for two-sample BF problem proposed by
  Srivastava et al. (2013)

## Some Existing Tests for GLHT Problem

- [`FHW2004.GLHT.NABT()`](FHW2004.GLHT.NABT.md) :
  Normal-approximation-based test for GLHT problem proposed by Fujikoshi
  et al. (2004)
- [`LHNB2025.GLHTBF.NABT()`](LHNB2025.GLHTBF.NABT.md) :
  Normal-approximation-based test for k-sample linear hypothesis via
  random integration proposed by Li et al. (2025)
- [`S2007.ks.NABT()`](S2007.ks.NABT.md) : Normal-approximation-based
  test for one-way MANOVA problem proposed by Schott (2007)
- [`SF2006.GLHT.NABT()`](SF2006.GLHT.NABT.md) :
  Normal-approximation-based test for GLHT problem proposed by
  Srivastava and Fujikoshi (2006)
- [`WZ2026.GLHTBF.2cNRT()`](WZ2026.GLHTBF.2cNRT.md) :
  F-approximation-based F-type test for GLHT problem under
  heteroscedasticity
- [`YS2012.GLHT.NABT()`](YS2012.GLHT.NABT.md) :
  Normal-approximation-based test for GLHT problem proposed by Yamada
  and Srivastava (2012)
- [`ZGZ2017.GLHTBF.NABT()`](ZGZ2017.GLHTBF.NABT.md) :
  Normal-approximation-based test for GLHT problem under
  heteroscedasticity proposed by Zhou et al. (2017)
